extension_name.description: The display name for the extension.

extension_description.message: Shows English translations in small letters above Lithuanian words, like furigana.
extension_description.description: Description of what the extension does.

popup_subtitle.description: Popup: line under the extension name.

popup_on.description: Popup: state of the main switch when the extension is on.

popup_off.description: Popup: state of the main switch when the extension is off.

popup_ai.description: Popup: label of the switch for Apple Intelligence glosses.

popup_translate.description: Popup: label of the menu that picks what gets translated.

popup_mode_page.description: Popup: translate mode, every word on the page.

popup_mode_hover.description: Popup: translate mode, the paragraph the pointer rests on.

popup_mode_select.description: Popup: translate mode, only text the user highlights.

popup_ai_available.description: Popup: status when Apple Intelligence can be used.

popup_ai_unavailable.message: On-device AI unavailable — using the offline dictionary
popup_ai_unavailable.description: Popup: status when Apple Intelligence cannot be used.

popup_hint.message: Translations appear in small letters above recognised Lithuanian words. Choose whether to translate the whole page, only the paragraph you rest the pointer on, or only text you highlight. On-device AI uses Apple Intelligence for context-aware meanings — private and free. Dictionary meanings appear instantly; the AI fills in the rest. Nothing leaves your device unless you turn on Google Translate.

popup_hide_common.description: Popup: label of the menu that hides the meanings of the most common words.

popup_hide_off.description: Popup: hide-common-words option that shows every meaning.

popup_hide_500.description: Popup: hide-common-words option for the 500 most frequent words.

popup_hide_2000.description: Popup: hide-common-words option for the 2,000 most frequent words.

popup_credits.message: Dictionary: Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0), the Hunspell lt_LT word list and FrequencyWords (CC BY-SA 4.0).
popup_credits.description: Popup: credit line for the dictionary data.

popup_credits_link.description: Popup: link to the dictionary data's source page.

popup_google.description: Popup: switch for the opt-in Google Translate context.

popup_google_note.message: Sends each paragraph the on-device AI glosses to Google, so the AI can pick better meanings. Needs the on-device AI and your own Cloud Translation API key.
popup_google_note.description: Popup: what turning on Google Translate does, and what it needs.

popup_saved.description: Popup: link to the page of words saved from word cards. The count follows in parentheses.
